# Activity stream response fixture

`latlng_response.json` is a synthetic, upstream-style `GET /activity/{id}/streams` response with non-athlete coordinates. It pins the public Intervals.icu behavior: for `latlng`, `data` is latitude and `data2` is longitude. The Intervals.icu maintainer clarified the second axis in the [latitude/longitude stream discussion](https://forum.intervals.icu/t/solved-possible-bug-on-latitude-longitude-stream/32420). The payload is constructed from that documented behavior; it is not copied from another server's source code or a private activity.

`issue64_nonzero_paused.json` is an actual Intervals.icu API response captured on 2026-09-30 after uploading an invented TCX run to the test account. It contains no real athlete or GPS samples. The synthetic recording has 2,858 one-second samples, 5–7,400 m cumulative distance, a 24-second distance plateau, and HR/power/cadence/altitude channels. The upstream API supplied `data2:null`, `valueTypeIsArray:false`, and nullable metadata for every scalar channel. Preserve those fields: earlier fixtures omitted null secondary fields and therefore missed the production failure. The live HR/pace histogram sample counts were 2857/2833, and the 0–120-second HR mean was 114 bpm (121 samples). The nonzero origin supports six complete absolute kilometre splits, numbered 2–7; it does not prove coverage of kilometre 1.
